blocks.text: Languages Xhosa, Sesotho, English With English subtitles

Once centred around Christianity, with the church serving as a sanctuary during apartheid, Tapoleng now finds itself negotiating shifting beliefs and identities. Blending interviews, improvised performance and observational footage, Mkulisi’s generous hybrid cinematic form embraces the rich textures of everyday life, creating a collaborative space in which her subjects represent and reimagine themselves on their own terms.

blocks.text: I Plant My Hand in the Garden

Playing versions of themselves as the central protagonists, Hoda Taheri and Boris Hadžija make a daring debut: a witty, irreverent and politically astute portrait of lives shaped by the search for belonging.
The Tiger Award winner at this year’s Rotterdam Film Festival is a gentle and enchanting portrait of an octogenarian goat herder in South Africa’s Kamiesberge.
Ashley Duong crafts a heartfelt hybrid film in response to her father’s memoir, which recounts his experiences of the Vietnam War and Iranian Revolution.
